description: This PHP source file defines the S3EndpointMiddleware class used to modify S3 request URLs to support features like S3 Accelerate, DualStack, and Path-style addressing within the AWS SDK for PHP. It handles the construction and application of various endpoint patterns based on command options and context.

classes.name: S3EndpointMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware responsible for constructing and modifying S3 endpoint URLs to support acceleration, dual-stack, and style options in requests.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a middleware instance encapsulated within a closure, configuring it with the region, endpoint provider, and options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the middleware with handler, region, options, and optional endpoint provider.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware to modify the request based on endpoint patterns and options, then calls the next handler.

methods.name: endpointPatternDecider
methods.description: Decides which endpoint style pattern to apply based on command options and context.

methods.name: canAccelerate
methods.description: Checks if the current command qualifies for acceleration.

methods.name: getBucketStyleHost
methods.description: Generates the host string for bucket-style addressing.

methods.name: applyHostStyleEndpoint
methods.description: Modifies the request URI to use host style endpoint.

methods.name: applyPathStyleEndpointCustomizations
methods.description: Adjusts request for path style endpoint, especially for special operations like 'WriteGetObjectResponse'.

methods.name: applyDualStackEndpoint
methods.description: Applies dual-stack endpoint modifications to the request.

methods.name: applyAccelerateEndpoint
methods.description: Configures the request URI for accelerate endpoints.

methods.name: getAccelerateHost
methods.description: Builds the host string for accelerate endpoint pattern.

methods.name: getBucketlessPath
methods.description: Generates the request path without the bucket name component.

methods.name: applyEndpoint
methods.description: Applies specific endpoint modifications based on ARNs, patterns, and command options.
